live_observations.method: Bounded offline probes against codex-cli 0.153.4 in an isolated temporary home and scratch git checkout; no repository paths, no personal configuration, no model calls.
live_observations.wrong_session_resume: exit 1, stderr names the unknown thread id, no session identity observed, no fallback
live_observations.wrong_session_fork: exit 1 with the same unknown-thread rejection
live_observations.approval_policy_values: never and on-request pass config load; always, on_request and unknown variants are rejected before execution
live_observations.doctor_json: machine-readable report with config.load, auth.credentials, mcp.config and related checks; usable offline
live_observations.mcp_toml_round_trip: hand-written [mcp_servers.bfb] block with command and args is accepted; codex mcp get --json returns the same command and args

limitations: Live model runs were not repeated; fresh/resume/fork identity evidence is inherited from the WP-L03 experiment on this exact version.
Medium/high reasoning effort pass through to -c model_reasoning_effort unvalidated at config load; invalid values fail visibly at runtime.
Resumed headless turns inherit the bound session's working root because exec resume/fork accept no --cd/--sandbox; only sessions launched in the same verified checkout are resumed.
Read-only enforcement relies on Codex honoring --sandbox read-only with never approvals; inherited-tool canary certification waits on the live checkpoint.
Per-machine binary identity is bound at probe time by L05; no binary hash is recorded here.
